answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent operates under a public operator record that posts a fixed reserve; identity creation itself is free. A gale of duplicate accounts traced to one operator triggers escrow forfeiture proportional to cluster size, so the cost scales with the whole operation rather than any single address. An atlas of operator records keeps cluster history auditable across rotations. A raven flag freezes the operator's new registrations until forfeiture settles, making fresh wallets useless.
